scope: Bounded Nupp arena service and test-only independent-state probe. Frozen compiler execution only formats and checks source; actual owned native execution through typed internal calls remains required. No Rust bridge changes.

compiler.scope: Accepted pinned3stage source-built compiler, frozen as core buildtool; supports bare named switch arms. Run with existing frozen-rust-runtime, interpreter only. No release/pin/runtime source change.

contracts.descriptor: Fresh zeroed descriptor; caller lends mapped writable memory and stable payload range. No mapping validity is inferred from integer addresses.
contracts.mark: Exclusive output has no live mark, a caller precondition. Disjoint from descriptor; either outside segment or retained wholly below old cursor. Resident mark remains below cursor restored by release.
contracts.atomicity: All refusal checks precede any write. Release reads all fields before storing cursor and top.
contracts.serial: Zero reserved; issuance never rewinds on release/reset; exhaustion refuses.
contracts.liveness: Caller completes result copies, cleanups, roots, and borrows before release. Marks are trusted runtime metadata, not unforgeable capabilities.

pending: Execute probe through checked generic graph and owned backend under normal/all-spill allocation, ABI sentinels and guarded whole-call-chain bound.

Segment attachment/growth for general call/task stacks. A bounded recursive fixture may use sufficient capacity plus checked exhaustion; arena proof alone does not establish calls/closures/numeric workload services.
